name: Aki
source: Kazuki's happy-go-lucky cousin. The 2nd oldest daughter of the Teshigahara family - she's outgoing, and sexually promiscuous. Currently unemployed, she enjoys sleeping most of the day, and hanging out with Kazuki when the chance arises.
